answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the garden audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the dawn band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 146 to 225 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the nebula identity is graded at all. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
